en.title: The Eternal Flame and the Harmonizer Awaiting Spring
en.premise: The promise of the 'cycle of seasons' once made with the gods has been forgotten, leaving the world trapped in an endless autumn. A girl gifted with the power to tune the seasons ventures into a sleepless city of eternal light to reclaim the lost 'spring.' There, she encounters an ancient radio that carries the voice of dawn, and a young god trembling in solitude.

zh.title: 常世之灯与候春的调律师
zh.premise: 曾经与众神缔结的“季节轮转”之约已被遗忘，世界被困在永无止境的秋天之中。拥有调律季节之术的少女，为了找回失落的“春天”，踏入了那座光芒永不熄灭的失眠之都。在那里，她遇见了一台传达黎明之声的陈旧无线电，以及一位在孤独中颤抖的年轻神明。
